character.name: Nerida
character.background: Circle of the Sea Druid · Lighthouse Keeper's Ward

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: You create a minor sensory effect related to nature within 30 feet, such as predicting the next hour's weather, causing a small wave to lap at a nearby shore, or making a single flower bloom instantly.

spells.name: Shape Water
spells.description: You manipulate a 5-foot cube of water within 30 feet, shaping it into simple forms, changing its flow, or creating harmless currents or eddies.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice within 60 feet regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.description: You create up to 10 gallons of clean, drinkable water within range, or destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container.

traits: Tide Speaker: You can communicate with and influence small bodies of water (up to a 30-foot cube) as if they were sentient, calming rough surf or rousing small waves with a word.
Storm-Touched: You have advantage on saving throws against lightning and thunder damage, a gift from the sea that resurrected you.
Lighthouse Navigator: You can navigate by lighthouse beacons even in total darkness, heavy fog, or driving rain, recalling every marker your keeper parent taught you.
Drowned One's Mark: Your fingertips are slightly webbed and perpetually cool to the touch, and you can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes, a remnant of the sea's bargain.
character.gear: Hide Armor · Carved Lighthouse Staff · Conch Shell Holy Symbol · Dried Sea Biscuits (x3) · Minor Healing Potion · Vial of Storm-Charged Seawater · Coil of Hemp Rope · Flint and Tinderbox
character.story: Born as the winter storm surge breached the lighthouse isle, Nerida was pulled from the waves by the keeper who found her cradled in phosphorescent kelp. She grew up listening to the sea's whispers, until the night she drowned a smuggler who threatened her keeper. The sea dragged her down, held her in its cold dark for three days, then spat her back, changed: her fingertips webbed, her voice carrying the crash of waves. Now she hunts the sunken city that haunts her dreams, the sea's bargain weighing on her soul.

inventory.name: Hide Armor
inventory.lore: Cured from the hide of a seal hunted in the frigid northern reefs, this armor has protected lighthouse keepers for three generations, its leather stiffened with shark oil to repel salt water.
inventory.description: Heavy, water-resistant leather armor, shaped to fit a human frame.

inventory.name: Carved Lighthouse Staff
inventory.lore: Whittled from driftwood that washed ashore the night Nerida was born, the staff is etched with spiral runes that glow faintly when the tide rises. Her keeper parent carved it for her 16th birthday, saying the sea had shaped the wood for her purpose.
inventory.description: A smooth, salt-stained quarterstaff carved with wave motifs and a tiny lighthouse at the top.

inventory.name: Conch Shell Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: A giant conch dredged from the reef where the sunken city's spires are said to rise. When held to the wind, it hums with the voices of drowned sailors, pointing unerringly toward the city's depths.
inventory.description: A polished pink conch shell strung on a woven kelp cord, warm to the touch even in freezing water.
inventory.effects: When activated as an action, the conch emits a low hum that reveals the direction of the nearest large body of water or sunken structure within 1 mile, for 10 minutes.

inventory.name: Dried Sea Biscuits
inventory.lore: Baked by the lighthouse keeper with barley flour, salt, and crushed dried kelp, these biscuits never go stale, tasting of brine even after weeks in a pack. They are the last three her keeper ever made.
inventory.description: Hard, crumbly biscuits sealed in waxed parchment, dense and salty.
inventory.effects: Eating one restores 1 hit point and satisfies hunger for 8 hours.

inventory.name: Minor Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Brewed from bioluminescent plankton that washes up on the lighthouse rocks during full moons. The keeper used it to treat sailors who broke bones in the surf, and left it to Nerida when they died.
inventory.description: A small glass vial filled with glowing blue liquid that shimmers like moonlight on water.
inventory.effects: When consumed, the drinker regains 1d4 + 1 hit points.

inventory.name: Vial of Storm-Charged Seawater
inventory.lore: Collected during the tempest that resurrected Nerida, the water crackles with static and glows faintly blue. It tingles with the raw power of the storm that pulled her back from the dead.
inventory.description: A stoppered glass vial filled with churning, electric-blue seawater that emits a faint ozone smell.
inventory.effects: When poured onto the ground as an action, it summons a 10ft long, 5ft wide wave that moves 30ft in a direction of your choice, extinguishing non-magical flames and pushing Medium or smaller creatures 10ft.

inventory.name: Coil of Hemp Rope
inventory.lore: The rope the keeper used to haul supplies up the 120-foot lighthouse tower. It's been mended a hundred times with fishing line, and smells of salt and tar even when bone-dry.
inventory.description: A 50-foot coil of thick, braided hemp rope, frayed at the ends but still strong.

inventory.name: Flint and Tinderbox
inventory.lore: A dented brass tinderbox the keeper salvaged from a shipwreck off the reefs. It works even in the heaviest rain, a gift from a grateful sailor whose life the keeper saved during a gale.
inventory.description: A small brass box containing flint, steel, and dry tinder wrapped in oiled cloth.
